diagnosis.what_happened: Table captions in parametric assumptions were bolded and Persian narrative paragraphs were not justified.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: The academic-writer used bold formatting (**...**) for table captions and omitted the <w:jc w:val='both'/> tag in DOCX narrative paragraphs.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Table captions must be regular weight B Nazanin 12pt, and all Persian narrative text must be explicitly justified.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Institutional and APA 7 guidelines explicitly prohibit bold table captions. Full justification is mandatory for Persian narrative formatting.

observed_failure.description: Validation checks failed on Stage 4.3 deliverable due to bold table captions and missing justification in Persian narrative.

desired_behavior: Enforce non-bold table captions in markdown and explicitly add justification tags (<w:jc w:val='both'/>) to Persian narrative paragraphs in DOCX.
generalization: Adhere strictly to APA 7th Edition formatting rules (no bold captions) and enforce explicit alignment tags in OpenXML for Persian text.
